MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The test leads and terminal strips fit my breadboards, relay module, and PCB supplies: they would help me test connections and turn temporary wiring into a more secure assembly.",
    "The caliper fits a practical mounting need: checking component and hardware dimensions would help with electronics assembly and projects like installing caster wheels."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The edge finder, pipe tap, and grinder wheel require specific machining or metalworking tasks that my recent projects do not establish.",
    "The signal generator relates to electronics, but I have no current waveform-testing task; similarly, the micrometer offers precision beyond my assembly needs.",
    "The syringes have no clear role in my current projects, and the filament assumes I use a 3D printer and need orange material, neither of which my history establishes."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of components and workshop hardware seem to have been treated as a broad interest in specialized tools, even when those tools serve unrelated tasks.",
    "An electronics connection seems to have been enough to suggest advanced test equipment, although my purchases give clearer reasons to recommend basic connection and assembly supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection between my breadboards, jumper wires, PCB boards, and relay is the need to connect, test, and secure small circuits.",
    "I choose items when they solve a concrete project need; sharing a general hobby is not enough to make me want another tool.",
    "My latest caster purchase adds a mounting and assembly context, which makes practical dimensional checks more relevant than specialized machining precision."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my hands-on assembly needs but stretched them into specialized workshop activities that I have no current reason to pursue."
}
